blindSummary:
This state/province is listed in the dossier among the jurisdictions with no sub-national signal: no enacted discriminatory bylaw, raid, arrest or incident series targeting transgender people was found, and it is NOT one of the eight states/provinces identified in an international LGBT-rights organisation's 2022 mapping study of discriminatory regional regulations (an earlier 'one of the eight' attribution for this jurisdiction rested on a sister jurisdiction of similar name on the same island - a misplacement).

For a visitor, this state/province therefore follows the national framework: the new national criminal code in force from 1 January 2026 criminalises same-sex conduct nationwide, and the organised local moral policing recorded in some other states/provinces is absent here - but there is no jurisdiction-specific enforcement record in either direction. Any risk follows the country's national framework rather than a local divergence.
blindSourceSummaries: An international LGBT-rights organisation's 2022 mapping study of national laws and regional regulations violating rights of women and LGBTIQ people: its eight-jurisdiction list of discriminatory regional regulations does NOT include this state/province, which is the basis for treating an earlier 'one of the eight' attribution here as a misplacement of a similarly-named sister jurisdiction on the same island.
